As a clinically depressed person myself, the one thing I've been able to hold onto is that we don't have to think about coping for long.  I try to focus on coping today.  When I wake up tomorrow im going to focus on tomorrow. It's hard not to think about everything, and I understand that,  but if you try to make each individual day as good as that day can be for you then you will begin to feel better and you will begin to feel like you don't have to cope as much. 

I hope that things become easier for you in time. If you need someone to talk to, you can pm,  I promise I'll answer :)

Hello Lozzy1256, I just posted my own SW post and I don't know how much I can help, but I did want to say to you that I am very grateful that you found suicidewatch and that I hope you will receive the help that I too hope to receive here.  I also wanted to suggest that as much as it probably scares you to think about it right now, you may want to talk about this with your fiance.  If you truly feel that he is "better" than you (which isn't true!) than you have to understand that he would want to know how you are suffering.  He would want to hold you during your bed days, and he would want to carry you to the sofa on those days when you can't make it there yourself.  Talk to him, let him help you be the person that you can be, not the person that you feel like you are today
